transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been bothering you or what brings you in today?

I guess I’ve just been… really worn out. I don’t want to make too much of it, but even getting from the bedroom to the kitchen feels like I’ve been hauling lumber all day. And resting doesn’t really seem to give me anything back, if that makes sense.
Have you noticed that you don't enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you've lost interest in activities you once found pleasurable?

Yeah… I mean, I don’t want to sound dramatic, but yes, I guess I have. I used to really look forward to choir, playing a little pickup ball, working on cars, grilling for the family… things like that.

Lately I just can’t seem to make myself care enough to go. Sometimes people text me about it and I don’t even answer, which isn’t great, I know. It’s not that they did anything wrong. I just… don’t have it in me.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, lately?

Yeah… I think so. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but most mornings I wake up with this heavy, hopeless feeling right in my chest. And some days I just end up sitting out in the garage crying, and I couldn’t even tell you what started it. Is that… is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?

Um… I’m not really sure. I haven’t been keeping close track of my weight or anything. My eating’s maybe a little off here and there, but I don’t know if it’s enough to call a change. Should I be paying more attention to that?
Have you noticed a significant loss of energy or increased fatigue nearly every day?

Yeah… yes, I have. I try not to make too big a deal out of it, but honestly that’s kind of what pushed me to come in.

I’m just… worn out all the time. Even walking from the bedroom to the kitchen can feel like I’ve been hauling lumber all day. And then I’ll sit down or rest, but it doesn’t really give me anything back, if that makes sense. Like I should feel a little better after resting, but I don’t.
Have you been feeling like you’re not worth much or that you’re letting people down, even when there’s no clear reason for it?

Yeah… I mean, I try not to wallow in it or anything, but… yes.

I keep thinking I’ve failed my wife, and my kids, and even people at church. Like I was supposed to be a better man than this, and I didn’t hold up my end. And then when bad things happen around us, I start feeling like… maybe it’s because of me. Like it’s some kind of punishment for not being who I was supposed to be.

I know that probably sounds dramatic. I’m not trying to make excuses. It just… it feels true sometimes.
Have you had any thoughts about life not being worth living or considered harming yourself?

I… I don’t want to scare anybody or make it sound worse than it is. But yes, those thoughts have been coming up.

It’s like this thought keeps coming into my head that I should just be dead. And when I’m around people I can kind of push it away, or at least act normal enough, but when I’m alone… that’s when it scares me. Because I start thinking I might actually do something to make that happen.

I’m sorry. I know that’s probably not the right kind of thing to say, but… it’s true.
Have you had episodes like this before, where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had trouble functioning, or is this the first time you’ve felt this way?

I guess… this is the first time it’s been like this for this long, or this bad.

It’s been going on about four months now, maybe a little more. It seemed to start after my wife went back to working full-time, and I was spending most weekdays by myself. I don’t want to blame that exactly, but that’s when I really noticed things changing.

I’m not sure if that answers what you’re asking.
